name: pluginstack-mcp
description: Search PluginStack's hand-checked directory of MCP servers, AI agent tools and setup guides.
long_description: Ask your AI client to find MCP servers and agent tools, get copy-paste install config for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and Codex, and read PluginStack's setup and troubleshooting guides. Read-only. Data comes from https://www.pluginstackai.com/directory.json, with a bundled snapshot as a fallback. No API key, no account, no tracking.
